requirements.statement: Internet visitors shall be able to open AtMem Architect through atmem.ai, submit an interaction and receive its result.
requirements.rationale: Visitors need a usable entry point to complete an Architect interaction through the named website.
requirements.basis: User: “I want to add atmem architect to atmem.ai so people in intenet can access it”.

requirements.statement: Visitors may chat without signing in after server-validated reCAPTCHA, subject to enforced usage credit. Terraform generation and downloads shall require Google sign-in or email sign-in verified by an emailed code, enforced server-side.
requirements.rationale: The answer permits chat before sign-in after CAPTCHA; exports retain the previously stated authentication requirement. Anonymous allowance ownership still needs a decision.
requirements.basis: User statement: they can chat but after ecaptch let's add limit of $1 to the user usage and ask them to top up if they want to use more

requirements.statement: Proposed: Visitors shall describe architectures through chat, view and refine their diagrams, and generate and download supported Terraform artifacts after authentication. Supported generation coverage shall be documented; whether Architect also applies Terraform to visitors’ cloud accounts remains an open scope decision.
requirements.rationale: Clarifies the intended visitor outcome while keeping cloud deployment an unresolved scope decision rather than an assumed capability.
requirements.basis: Existing requirement ai-chat-draw-export and the recorded request for chat, drawings, Terraform generation and authenticated downloads.

requirements.statement: The system shall report instrumented visitor clicks, session engagement time, Terraform-generation events and downloads, with collection limits documented; consent, retention and event contents remain proposed decisions.
requirements.rationale: Supports understanding visitor behaviour; explicit event definitions and measurement limits are needed to avoid interpreting incomplete browser telemetry as a complete record.
requirements.basis: “analytics for the vistiors knowing exactly what they clicked howlong they stay”

requirements.statement: The application shall enforce a $1 per-user usage allowance server-side, stop additional chargeable work when available credit is exhausted, and offer paid top-ups. Balance reservations and settlement shall be atomic, and credit shall be added only after verified, idempotent payment confirmation. Currency, renewal period, usage valuation and anonymous identity rules remain open.
requirements.rationale: Concurrent requests and repeated payment notifications could otherwise overspend balances or credit the same payment twice. The allowance is distinct from the project's monthly cloud budget.
requirements.basis: Current request: "let's add limit of $1 to the user usage and ask them to top up if they want to use more".

requirements.statement: Proposed: AtMem memory reads and writes shall enforce visitor/account and project ownership on the server; unknown ownership shall deny access. Anonymous-to-account linking shall require an explicit authorization policy before enabling cross-visit recall.
requirements.rationale: Proposed isolation prevents one internet visitor's remembered information from appearing in another visitor's answers; identity linking needs an explicit design.
requirements.basis: The user asks where the AtMem memory accompanying Architect will go; the diagram includes public visitors and proposed Firebase Authentication.

notes.current: AtMem AI Architect proposal — confirm: Baseline is revision 13: existing Firebase Hosting with proposed Cloud Run, Firebase Authentication, reCAPTCHA, Firestore and GA4 integrations. It preserves the current website and accepted GCP decision, reducing migration effort. Cloud Run generation and application integrations remain unfinished; no runtime checks ran. Model integration, payment provider, emailed-code delivery and anonymous credit identity remain unresolved. Scores assess architectural potential, not demonstrated behavior; no running-cost estimate exists.
notes.aws: AtMem AI Architect proposal — confirm: Candidate: retain Firebase Hosting and run Architect on Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate, using Amazon DynamoDB for credit and memory and Amazon Cognito for identity; Amazon Bedrock is a possible model integration, not a selected replacement. This adds cross-cloud routing and identity work, or website migration if hosting also moves. Emailed codes, CAPTCHA, payments, analytics and SDK persistence need explicit implementations. Existing AWS generator coverage does not implement this application. Australian placement, model availability and residency remain unverified; cost is unpriced.
notes.azure: AtMem AI Architect proposal — confirm: Candidate: Azure Container Apps for Architect, Azure Cosmos DB for credit and memory, and Microsoft Entra External ID for visitor identity, retaining Firebase Hosting initially. Credit transactions require a deliberate partition design; the memory adapter and exact emailed-code flow need qualification. No Microsoft integration requirement currently offsets the added cross-cloud work. CAPTCHA, analytics, payments and model integration remain application work. Regional availability, residency and recovery are unverified, and this stack lacks native application generation here; cost is unpriced.
notes.gcp: AtMem AI Architect proposal — confirm: This is the current approach, not an independent alternative: Firebase Hosting, Cloud Run, Firebase Authentication, reCAPTCHA, Firestore and GA4 match the existing website and accepted preference. Shared platform ownership reduces migration work, but Firebase rewrites, SDK persistence and server-enforced credit/export authorization still need implementation. Exact emailed-code sign-in needs a custom flow and delivery service. Vertex AI is only a candidate if compatible with the application's model needs. Australia does not establish residency for every service; availability and processing boundaries are unverified. Cost is unpriced.
notes.ibm: AtMem AI Architect proposal — confirm: Candidate: IBM Cloud Code Engine for Architect, IBM Cloudant for persistence and watsonx.ai for a compatible model, retaining Firebase Hosting and qualifying external visitor authentication. Cloudant needs a proven reservation and settlement design; Firestore transaction behavior cannot simply be assumed. This adds cross-cloud operations and memory-adapter work without a stated IBM dependency. Identity, CAPTCHA, payments and analytics remain integration work. Australian service/model availability, residency, quotas and plans require verification. Native generation does not implement this stack; cost is unpriced.
